reviews.text: We’ve always wanted a covered patio and Kenny and Deck Masters delivered in spades! We highly recommend him and his team because: Kenny had great designs that sparked our excitement, he did ALL the work - pristinely- to satisfy our HOA, had connections for concrete, roofing and the staining done after completion, his team was very quick, friendly and impressively organized. And all for a very fair price. We are so happy, thank you Deck Masters!

We also had an electrician move a patio ceiling outlet and do some related work, due to the pergola. The electrician also has worked with Kenny on decks and pergola projects. We are very happy with the end results. We got just what we wanted. We also plan to work with the stainer and electrician on some other projects. The team at Deck Masters did an amazing job and the final product was perfect. We had a vision and they were able to walk us through every step and connect us with professionals for every phase from prepping the HOA to staining and concrete. They went above and beyond to make sure we were happy with everything in a timely manner. We can’t recommend them enough to anyone that needs a patio placed! We love our space outside!

Kenny @ Deckmasters AND his guys, were great. The crews knew exactly what & how to give us an excellent covered patio.
A flawless experience- done on time - and on budget…
All question's I had during the build, were addressed professionally and immediately…
Appreciate the end results Kenny..!

Kenny and his team were fantastic to work with. My previous home had the same patio layout and I was told that it would not be possible to cover it. Kenny and his crew were amazing. Everything turned out exactly how we planned. Never had a patio like this! All around a great experience.

Deck masters did a wonderful job. They were quick and helped us every step of the way from the style and color of the concrete to selecting the best stain color for the cedar patio cover. The price quoted was honored by the concrete company, patio builders and stain crew.

We had Kenny @ Deckmasters of Rockwall custom build a back porch for our home.  Kenny came out talked with us and gave us an estimate that day. He is very knowledgeable about his business.  We had the porch done by Deckmasters and are so pleased and happy how it came out.  His guys are true craftsman and awesome builders.  The porch is beautiful, we love the cedar and will enjoy it for a very long time. It added a lot of value to our home and a lot of enjoyment to our lives.

Could not be more happy with this. Brad was excellent with and answered all my questions and set everything up. The work crews was courteous and knowledgeable. Overall very happy and recommend them highly.

The turnaround time was super fast and we are super pleased!  Thanks Deck Masters for completing my back yard.

Highly recommend this company!!!!

data.summary: The reviews themselves read as authentic, with specific, credible details. However, the extremely low volume of reviews for a company in business for over 50 years is a significant anomaly. The complete absence of any critical feedback in the sample is also unusual. This suggests the online review presence may not be representative of the company's full customer base, but the existing positive reviews do not show clear signs of fabrication.
fake_signals: Very low review volume (23 total) for a 52-year-old company
All sampled Google reviews are 5-star with no critical feedback
Multiple anonymous reviews on HQ profile
authentic_signals: Specific details in reviews (crew names Brad/Kenny, project types, timelines)
Mention of real-world processes (HOA, staining, concrete, connections with other trades)
Varied writing styles and specific praise points
data.discrepancy_explanation: Limited data across platforms. The available Google rating is high, and the BBB rating is middling but not contradictory given the lack of complaint/review data there.
